Package aor.proj3t.daos.impl

Class MessageDAOimpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.AbstractDAO<Message,Long>
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.MessageDAOimpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
BasicDAO<Message,Long>, MessageDAO
public class MessageDAOimpl extends AbstractDAO<Message,Long> implements MessageDAO
Stateless EJB implementation of the MessageDAO interface.

This class provides concrete implementation for managing internal messaging operations within the application. It extends AbstractDAO to leverage common CRUD operations and implements specific business logic for message management, conversation tracking, and notification support.

Key implementation features:

  • Efficient JPQL queries for message filtering and retrieval
  • Optimized conversation participant discovery
  • Unread message counting for notification systems
  • Atomic message status updates with timestamps
  • Support for bilateral conversation queries

    • findBySenderId

      public List<Message> findBySenderId(Long senderId)
      Retrieves all messages sent by a specific user.

      This method finds all messages where the specified user is the sender. Useful for displaying user's sent message history and outbox functionality.

      Implementation uses JPQL query to find all messages where the sender ID matches the specified parameter. Uses entity relationship navigation for efficient querying.

      Specified by:
      findBySenderId in interface MessageDAO
      Parameters:
      senderId - The unique identifier of the sender. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of messages sent by the specified user, or an empty list if no messages are found

    • findBySenderIdAndRecipientId

      public List<Message> findBySenderIdAndRecipientId(Long senderId, Long recipientId)
      Retrieves all messages exchanged between two specific users.

      This method finds all messages where one user is the sender and the other is the recipient, regardless of direction. Useful for displaying complete conversation history between two users.

      Implementation uses JPQL query with multiple conditions to find messages sent from a specific sender to a specific recipient. This provides unidirectional conversation history.

      Specified by:
      findBySenderIdAndRecipientId in interface MessageDAO
      Parameters:
      senderId - The unique identifier of the sender. Must not be null.
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the recipient. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of messages exchanged between the sender and recipient, or an empty list if no messages are found

    • findMessagedUsers

      public List<User> findMessagedUsers(Long userId)
      Retrieves all unique users that have exchanged messages with a given user.

      This method finds all users who have either sent messages to or received messages from the specified user. Essential for displaying conversation participants and contact lists.

      Implementation uses a complex JPQL query with CASE expressions to find all unique users who have had message exchanges with the specified user. The query efficiently handles both sent and received messages in a single database operation.

      Specified by:
      findMessagedUsers in interface MessageDAO
      Parameters:
      userId - The unique identifier of the user. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of unique users who have interacted with the specified user, or an empty list if no interactions are found

    • findCountUnreadMessagesByRecipientId

      public Integer findCountUnreadMessagesByRecipientId(Long recipientId)
      Counts the total number of unread messages for a specific user.

      This method provides a count of all messages received by the user that have not been marked as read. Essential for notification badges and message alerts in the user interface.

      Implementation uses COUNT function in JPQL to efficiently count unread messages without loading full message entities. Filters by recipient ID and read status.

      Specified by:
      findCountUnreadMessagesByRecipientId in interface MessageDAO
      Parameters:
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the recipient. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The count of unread messages, or 0 if no unread messages exist

    • findCountUnreadMessagesBetweenUsers

      public Integer findCountUnreadMessagesBetweenUsers(Long recipientId, Long senderId)
      Counts unread messages between two specific users.

      This method provides a count of unread messages from a specific sender to a specific recipient. Useful for displaying conversation-specific unread message counts.

      Implementation uses COUNT function with multiple conditions to count unread messages between specific users. This is useful for conversation-specific unread indicators in messaging interfaces.

      Specified by:

      Parameters:
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the recipient. Must not be null.
      senderId - The unique identifier of the sender. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The count of unread messages from sender to recipient, or 0 if none exist

    • markMessageAsRead

      public Boolean markMessageAsRead(Long messageId)
      Marks a specific message as read.

      This method updates the read status of a message to indicate that it has been viewed by the recipient. This affects unread message counts and notification states.

      Implementation uses an UPDATE query to atomically mark a message as read and set the read timestamp. Returns success status based on the number of affected rows.

      Specified by:
      markMessageAsRead in interface MessageDAO
      Parameters:
      messageId - The unique identifier of the message to mark as read. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      true if the message was successfully marked as read, false if the operation failed or the message was not found
